newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco Systems shares fall.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco Systems shares fall.

text.p: Shares of Cisco Systems fell 1/4 after hours to move at 61-1/2, traders said.
The company posted first-quarter earnings of $0.26 per share compared with $0.28 per share.
The current earnings include a charge of $0.26 per share and a gain of $0.05 per share.
The shares continued to fall as low as 61 within an hour after the company released its results.

Based in San Jose, Calif., the company is the world's largest maker of networking devices. Its first-quarter profits from operations rose 77 percent to $320.8 million, or $0.47 per share, slightly better than the First Call estimate of $0.46 per share.
Apart from Cisco, after-hours traders said volume was light.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 603,300 shares compared with 18,400 shares on Monday. Session two volume was 6,193,161 shares compared with 7,683,800 shares on Monday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
